name: FNBO Evergreen Business Edition Credit Card

localized_names.en: FNBO Evergreen Business Edition Credit Card

apr.notes: 0% intro APR on purchases for the first 6 billing cycles after account opening, then a variable APR based on the Prime Rate between 17.49% and 28.24%.

base_rate.description: 2% cash back, earned as points, on purchases.

signup_bonus.description: $200 cash bonus (20,000 points equivalent) after spending $3,000 within the first 3 billing cycles after account opening.

notes: Earn 10,000 bonus points annually with $10,000 in spend. Maximum credit limit is $50,000. No Mastercard network package is stated, so network_tier is none.
